TEXT.English: +20% unit production, -20% research, +100% distance and city-count maintenance.
TEXT.French: +20% unit production, -20% research, +100% distance and city-count maintenance.
TEXT.German: +20% Einheitenproduktion, -20% Forschung, +100% entfernungs- und städtezahlabhängiger Unterhalt.
TEXT.Italian: +20% unit production, -20% research, +100% distance and city-count maintenance.
TEXT.Spanish: +20% unit production, -20% research, +100% distance and city-count maintenance.

TEXT.English: Capital buildings give +1 culture and +1 commerce each; capital world wonders give +1 happiness empire-wide, capped at +3. Enables inheritance events.
TEXT.French: Capital buildings give +1 culture and +1 commerce each; capital world wonders give +1 happiness empire-wide, capped at +3. Enables inheritance events.
TEXT.German: Hauptstadtgebäude geben je +1 Kultur und +1 Handel; Weltwunder der Hauptstadt geben reichsweit +1 Zufriedenheit, maximal +3. Ermöglicht Erbfolgeereignisse.
TEXT.Italian: Capital buildings give +1 culture and +1 commerce each; capital world wonders give +1 happiness empire-wide, capped at +3. Enables inheritance events.
TEXT.Spanish: Capital buildings give +1 culture and +1 commerce each; capital world wonders give +1 happiness empire-wide, capped at +3. Enables inheritance events.

TEXT.English: Assigned non-slave specialists consume 1 less food. Free specialists and settled Great People are excluded.
TEXT.French: Assigned non-slave specialists consume 1 less food. Free specialists and settled Great People are excluded.
TEXT.German: Zugewiesene Spezialisten außer Sklaven verbrauchen 1 Nahrung weniger. Freie Spezialisten und angesiedelte Große Persönlichkeiten sind ausgenommen.
TEXT.Italian: Assigned non-slave specialists consume 1 less food. Free specialists and settled Great People are excluded.
TEXT.Spanish: Assigned non-slave specialists consume 1 less food. Free specialists and settled Great People are excluded.

TEXT.English: +20% production and no war weariness, but -2 happiness in every city.
TEXT.French: +20% production and no war weariness, but -2 happiness in every city.
TEXT.German: +20% Produktion und keine Kriegsmüdigkeit, aber -2 Zufriedenheit in jeder Stadt.
TEXT.Italian: +20% production and no war weariness, but -2 happiness in every city.
TEXT.Spanish: +20% production and no war weariness, but -2 happiness in every city.

TEXT.English: +2 happiness in every city and +1 commerce per specialist. Adoption randomizes all other civics; elections change one every ten turns. Other columns cannot be changed manually while Democracy is retained. Leaving Democracy adds two turns of anarchy. No stability penalties from incompatible civics.
TEXT.French: +2 happiness in every city and +1 commerce per specialist. Adoption randomizes all other civics; elections change one every ten turns. Other columns cannot be changed manually while Democracy is retained. Leaving Democracy adds two turns of anarchy. No stability penalties from incompatible civics.
TEXT.German: +2 Zufriedenheit in jeder Stadt und +1 Handel je Spezialist. Bei Einführung werden alle anderen Staatsformen zufällig gewählt; Wahlen ändern alle zehn Runden eine davon. Andere Kategorien können bei Beibehaltung der Demokratie nicht manuell gewechselt werden. Ihre Abschaffung verlängert Anarchie um zwei Runden. Keine Stabilitätsmali durch unvereinbare Staatsformen.
TEXT.Italian: +2 happiness in every city and +1 commerce per specialist. Adoption randomizes all other civics; elections change one every ten turns. Other columns cannot be changed manually while Democracy is retained. Leaving Democracy adds two turns of anarchy. No stability penalties from incompatible civics.
TEXT.Spanish: +2 happiness in every city and +1 commerce per specialist. Adoption randomizes all other civics; elections change one every ten turns. Other columns cannot be changed manually while Democracy is retained. Leaving Democracy adds two turns of anarchy. No stability penalties from incompatible civics.

TEXT.English: +1 happiness from palaces and monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.French: +1 happiness from palaces and monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.German: +1 Zufriedenheit durch Paläste und Monumente, einschließlich einzigartiger Ersatzgebäude.
TEXT.Italian: +1 happiness from palaces and monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 happiness from palaces and monuments, including unique replacements.

TEXT.English: +15% land combat strength against barbarians and countries with a different or no state religion; requires your own state religion. State-religion buildings give +1 happiness; other religious buildings give -2 happiness.
TEXT.French: +15% land combat strength against barbarians and countries with a different or no state religion; requires your own state religion. State-religion buildings give +1 happiness; other religious buildings give -2 happiness.
TEXT.German: +15% Kampfstärke für Landeinheiten gegen Barbaren und Länder mit anderer oder keiner Staatsreligion; erfordert eigene Staatsreligion. Gebäude der Staatsreligion geben +1 Zufriedenheit, andere religiöse Gebäude -2 Zufriedenheit.
TEXT.Italian: +15% land combat strength against barbarians and countries with a different or no state religion; requires your own state religion. State-religion buildings give +1 happiness; other religious buildings give -2 happiness.
TEXT.Spanish: +15% land combat strength against barbarians and countries with a different or no state religion; requires your own state religion. State-religion buildings give +1 happiness; other religious buildings give -2 happiness.

TEXT.English: +25% gold income and +50% trade-route commerce.
TEXT.French: +25% gold income and +50% trade-route commerce.
TEXT.German: +25% Goldeinnahmen und +50% Wirtschaftspunkte durch Handelsrouten.
TEXT.Italian: +25% gold income and +50% trade-route commerce.
TEXT.Spanish: +25% gold income and +50% trade-route commerce.

TEXT.English: +5 culture per city and +20% production. -5 happiness where another player's city-tile culture exceeds the owner's.
TEXT.French: +5 culture per city and +20% production. -5 happiness where another player's city-tile culture exceeds the owner's.
TEXT.German: +5 Kultur je Stadt und +20% Produktion. -5 Zufriedenheit, wenn die Kultur eines anderen Spielers auf dem Stadtfeld größer ist als die des Besitzers.
TEXT.Italian: +5 culture per city and +20% production. -5 happiness where another player's city-tile culture exceeds the owner's.
TEXT.Spanish: +5 culture per city and +20% production. -5 happiness where another player's city-tile culture exceeds the owner's.

TEXT.English: +2 happiness in every city and +10% commerce.
TEXT.French: +2 happiness in every city and +10% commerce.
TEXT.German: +2 Zufriedenheit in jeder Stadt und +10% Wirtschaftspunkte.
TEXT.Italian: +2 happiness in every city and +10% commerce.
TEXT.Spanish: +2 happiness in every city and +10% commerce.

TEXT.English: +2 health in every city. Cottage improvements stop growing; assigned specialists are blocked, but free specialists remain.
TEXT.French: +2 health in every city. Cottage improvements stop growing; assigned specialists are blocked, but free specialists remain.
TEXT.German: +2 Gesundheit in jeder Stadt. Hüttenverbesserungen wachsen nicht; zugewiesene Spezialisten sind gesperrt, freie Spezialisten bleiben.
TEXT.Italian: +2 health in every city. Cottage improvements stop growing; assigned specialists are blocked, but free specialists remain.
TEXT.Spanish: +2 health in every city. Cottage improvements stop growing; assigned specialists are blocked, but free specialists remain.

TEXT.English: Enables slave specialists. Enslave conquered peoples.
TEXT.French: Enables slave specialists. Enslave conquered peoples.
TEXT.German: Ermöglicht Sklavenspezialisten. Versklavt eroberte Völker.
TEXT.Italian: Enables slave specialists. Enslave conquered peoples.
TEXT.Spanish: Enables slave specialists. Enslave conquered peoples.

TEXT.English: +1 food from farms, -1 commerce from villages, workers build improvements 50% faster, and population can rush units.
TEXT.French: +1 food from farms, -1 commerce from villages, workers build improvements 50% faster, and population can rush units.
TEXT.German: +1 Nahrung durch Bauernhöfe, -1 Wirtschaftspunkt durch Dörfer; Bautrupps errichten Verbesserungen 50% schneller und Bevölkerung kann Einheiten beschleunigen.
TEXT.Italian: +1 food from farms, -1 commerce from villages, workers build improvements 50% faster, and population can rush units.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 food from farms, -1 commerce from villages, workers build improvements 50% faster, and population can rush units.

TEXT.English: +1 production from workshops, watermills and windmills; +1 food from farms; -10% commerce. No trade routes with Capitalists.
TEXT.French: +1 production from workshops, watermills and windmills; +1 food from farms; -10% commerce. No trade routes with Capitalists.
TEXT.German: +1 Produktion durch Werkstätten, Wasser- und Windmühlen; +1 Nahrung durch Bauernhöfe; -10% Wirtschaftspunkte. Keine Handelswege mit Kapitalisten.
TEXT.Italian: +1 production from workshops, watermills and windmills; +1 food from farms; -10% commerce. No trade routes with Capitalists.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 production from workshops, watermills and windmills; +1 food from farms; -10% commerce. No trade routes with Capitalists.

TEXT.English: +1 free specialist in every city; cottage improvements grow twice as fast. No trade routes with Communists.
TEXT.French: +1 free specialist in every city; cottage improvements grow twice as fast. No trade routes with Communists.
TEXT.German: +1 freier Spezialist in jeder Stadt; Hüttenverbesserungen wachsen doppelt so schnell. Keine Handelswege mit Kommunisten.
TEXT.Italian: +1 free specialist in every city; cottage improvements grow twice as fast. No trade routes with Communists.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 free specialist in every city; cottage improvements grow twice as fast. No trade routes with Communists.

TEXT.English: Melee units start with +2 experience; siege units have -20% combat strength.
TEXT.French: Melee units start with +2 experience; siege units have -20% combat strength.
TEXT.German: Nahkampfeinheiten starten mit +2 Erfahrung; Belagerungseinheiten haben -20% Kampfstärke.
TEXT.Italian: Melee units start with +2 experience; siege units have -20% combat strength.
TEXT.Spanish: Melee units start with +2 experience; siege units have -20% combat strength.

TEXT.English: +30% city defense, but -10% combat strength outside your own territory.
TEXT.French: +30% city defense, but -10% combat strength outside your own territory.
TEXT.German: +30% Stadtverteidigung, aber -10% Kampfstärke außerhalb des eigenen Gebiets.
TEXT.Italian: +30% city defense, but -10% combat strength outside your own territory.
TEXT.Spanish: +30% city defense, but -10% combat strength outside your own territory.

TEXT.English: +6 experience for newly trained mounted units.
TEXT.French: +6 experience for newly trained mounted units.
TEXT.German: +6 Erfahrung für neu ausgebildete berittene Einheiten.
TEXT.Italian: +6 experience for newly trained mounted units.
TEXT.Spanish: +6 experience for newly trained mounted units.

TEXT.English: Units start with +5 experience.
TEXT.French: Units start with +5 experience.
TEXT.German: Einheiten starten mit +5 Erfahrung.
TEXT.Italian: Units start with +5 experience.
TEXT.Spanish: Units start with +5 experience.

TEXT.English: +25% unit production. Food surplus contributes to land military unit production.
TEXT.French: +25% unit production. Food surplus contributes to land military unit production.
TEXT.German: +25% Einheitenproduktion. Nahrungsüberschuss trägt zur Produktion militärischer Landeinheiten bei.
TEXT.Italian: +25% unit production. Food surplus contributes to land military unit production.
TEXT.Spanish: +25% unit production. Food surplus contributes to land military unit production.

TEXT.English: +1 culture from monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.French: +1 culture from monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.German: +1 Kultur durch Monumente, einschließlich einzigartiger Ersatzgebäude.
TEXT.Italian: +1 culture from monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 culture from monuments, including unique replacements.

TEXT.English: +1 happiness in cities with the state religion; +100% production for missionaries of any religion.
TEXT.French: +1 happiness in cities with the state religion; +100% production for missionaries of any religion.
TEXT.German: +1 Zufriedenheit in Städten mit Staatsreligion; +100% Produktion für Missionare aller Religionen.
TEXT.Italian: +1 happiness in cities with the state religion; +100% production for missionaries of any religion.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 happiness in cities with the state religion; +100% production for missionaries of any religion.

TEXT.English: Cities with the state religion gain +2 happiness and +10% production; cities without it get -2 happiness.
TEXT.French: Cities with the state religion gain +2 happiness and +10% production; cities without it get -2 happiness.
TEXT.German: Städte mit Staatsreligion erhalten +2 Zufriedenheit und +10% Produktion; Städte ohne sie erhalten -2 Zufriedenheit.
TEXT.Italian: Cities with the state religion gain +2 happiness and +10% production; cities without it get -2 happiness.
TEXT.Spanish: Cities with the state religion gain +2 happiness and +10% production; cities without it get -2 happiness.

TEXT.English: No unhappiness from non-state religions and no different-religion diplomatic penalties involving your country. +2 relations toward you from countries with a different state religion, except State Atheism.
TEXT.French: No unhappiness from non-state religions and no different-religion diplomatic penalties involving your country. +2 relations toward you from countries with a different state religion, except State Atheism.
TEXT.German: Keine Unzufriedenheit durch fremde Religionen und keine diplomatischen Religionsmali mit eurem Land. +2 Beziehungen zu euch bei Ländern mit anderer Staatsreligion, außer Staatsatheismus.
TEXT.Italian: No unhappiness from non-state religions and no different-religion diplomatic penalties involving your country. +2 relations toward you from countries with a different state religion, except State Atheism.
TEXT.Spanish: No unhappiness from non-state religions and no different-religion diplomatic penalties involving your country. +2 relations toward you from countries with a different state religion, except State Atheism.

TEXT.English: +10% research and +10% production; -1 happiness in all cities. Religious buildings have no effects and religions cannot spread.
TEXT.French: +10% research and +10% production; -1 happiness in all cities. Religious buildings have no effects and religions cannot spread.
TEXT.German: +10% Forschung und +10% Produktion; -1 Zufriedenheit in allen Städten. Religiöse Gebäude wirken nicht und Religionen verbreiten sich nicht.
TEXT.Italian: +10% research and +10% production; -1 happiness in all cities. Religious buildings have no effects and religions cannot spread.
TEXT.Spanish: +10% research and +10% production; -1 happiness in all cities. Religious buildings have no effects and religions cannot spread.
